title: Pokemon Fire Red
description: The definitive classic creature-collection RPG. Embark on a journey across the Kanto region to become a Pokemon Master.

title: Pokemon Emerald Green
description: The enhanced version of Pokemon Ruby and Sapphire. Explore the Hoenn region and capture the legendary Rayquaza.

title: Pokemon Silver Soul
description: Travel back to the Johto region in this legendary remake. Experience the classic silver journey with enhanced graphics and features.

title: Pokemon Ruby
description: The landmark third-generation Pokemon game. Explore the Hoenn region, stop Team Magma, and discover the power of Groudon.

title: Pokemon Platinum
description: The definitive Sinnoh experience. Venture into the Distortion World, challenge the Battle Frontier, and capture the legendary Giratina.

title: Pokemon Black 2
description: Return to the Unova region two years later. Experience new areas, new challenges, and the climax of the Black & White saga.

title: Pokemon White 2
description: The counterpart to Black 2. Discover the mysteries of the White Kyurem and embark on an epic adventure in Unova.

title: Pokemon X and Y
description: Step into the beautiful Kalos region, discover the mystery of Mega Evolution, and encounter the legendary Xerneas and Yveltal.
